title: eBill registration status updated
description: This event occurs when an eBill registration status changes on the Pismo platform. The post eBill registration endpoint generates this event.

external_id.title: External ID
external_id.description: The external ID for eBill registration.

old_status.title: Old eBill registration status
old_status.description: Previous status of the eBill registration.

error_message.description: The error message indicating registration error.
